name: SLR Consulting
desc: UK-founded environmental and sustainability consultancy, backed by Ares Management, with 5,000+ staff and 140+ offices, working in 127 countries.

name: Giti Tire

name: Genstar Capital

name: GI Partners

name: Grand Frais
